source.name: SNAP soc-Pokec social network
source.citation: L. Takac, M. Zabovsky. Data Analysis in Public Social Networks, International Scientific Conference & International Workshop Present Day Trends of Innovations, May 2012 Lomza, Poland.

subsample.method: Vitter Algorithm R reservoir sample of directed edges from soc-pokec-relationships.txt.gz; sample then sorted by (src, dst); node set = endpoints of sampled edges.

notes: Raw SNAP dump stays in data/raw/ (gitignored).
CSV row order is sorted by (start_id, end_id) after sampling so artifact checksums are stable across machines.
RNG is Python random.Random(seed) with Vitter's Algorithm R.
